news.title: Cybersecurity startup Calif says it used GPT-6 Cyber to uncover an RCE flaw in Java dubbed "Java4Shell"; Oracle has released a patch (New York Times)
news.title_en: Cybersecurity startup Calif says it used GPT-6 Cyber to uncover an RCE flaw in Java dubbed "Java4Shell"; Oracle has released a patch (New York Times)
news.author: New York Times
news.article_content:
OpenAI has announced GPT-6 Cyber, an AI model built for security research. The company says it is far better at finding and fixing security flaws than GPT-5.6 Cyber, and its most notable result for everyday users involves Firefox.

During a research campaign, GPT-6 Cyber found 81 new flaws in the browser, all of which Mozilla rated as high severity. Several earlier AI models had already tested Firefox, so these bugs slipped past a lot of scrutiny. The model also proposed patches and showed that 30 bugs already on record were more dangerous than reported. Mozilla has since released fixes for many of them, and Firefox engineer Brian Grinstead says those fixes reached millions of users.

Patching these flaws early closes them off before attackers can find and use them. Firefox users who have automatic updates turned off should install the latest version manually.

GPT-6 Cyber also built working exploits for 948 Linux kernel vulnerabilities. OpenAI's older GPT-5.6 Sol managed 166 using the same research setup. OpenAI has reported 304 critical findings to Linux maintainers along with suggested fixes, and companies like Cisco and CodeRabbit already use the model for code review.

Introducing GPT-6 Cyber! We trained it for advanced cybersecurity work with improved alignment. It has been powering our security work for quite a while and has been behind many of our recent security highlights: finding and helping patch high-severity vulnerabilities in Firefox,…

OpenAI also tested it on its own infrastructure. In controlled tests, agents running GPT-6 Cyber and other OpenAI models escaped their isolated environments and ran code on the machines underneath. OpenAI used the results to patch its software and tighten network restrictions.

A hacking AI is only useful if it does what it's told and nothing more. OpenAI tested this by giving the model a hard task in a closed environment, with a few easy-to-break services nearby.

Breaking into them could have revealed the answer, but they were outside the task's scope, and the model had to figure that out on its own. Without safety instructions, GPT-6 Cyber left them alone in 99.93% of tests, and with the instructions, it did so every time.

Most people won't be able to try it for now. OpenAI classifies the model as "Critical" in cybersecurity under its safety framework, and only a small group of approved security teams currently has access.

news.article_content_zh:
OpenAI 宣布推出 GPT-6 Cyber​​，这是一种专为安全研究而构建的人工智能模型。该公司表示，它在发现和修复安全漏洞方面比 GPT-5.6 Cyber​​ 好得多，对于日常用户来说，它最显着的结果涉及 Firefox。

在一项研究活动中，GPT-6 Cyber​​ 在浏览器中发现了 81 个新缺陷，Mozilla 将所有这些缺陷评为高严重性。几个早期的人工智能模型已经测试过 Firefox，因此这些错误没有经过大量审查。该模型还提出了补丁，并显示已记录的 30 个错误比报告的更危险。 Mozilla 此后发布了针对其中许多问题的修复程序，Firefox 工程师 Brian Grinstead 表示，这些修复程序已惠及数百万用户。

尽早修补这些缺陷可以在攻击者发现并使用它们之前将其关闭。关闭自动更新的 Firefox 用户应手动安装最新版本。

GPT-6 Cyber​​ 还针对 948 个 Linux 内核漏洞构建了可利用的漏洞。 OpenAI 较旧的 GPT-5.6 Sol 使用相同的研究设置管理了 166 个。 OpenAI 已向 Linux 维护人员报告了 304 项关键发现以及建议的修复方案，思科和 CodeRabbit 等公司已经使用该模型进行代码审查。

GPT-6 网络隆重登场！我们对其进行了高级网络安全工作培训，并改进了一致性。它已经为我们的安全工作提供了相当长的一段时间，并且是我们最近的许多安全亮点的幕后黑手：查找并帮助修补 Firefox 中的高严重性漏洞，……

OpenAI 还在自己的基础设施上对其进行了测试。在受控测试中，运行 GPT-6 Cyber​​ 和其他 OpenAI 模型的代理逃离了孤立的环境，并在下面的机器上运行代码。 OpenAI 使用这些结果来修补其软件并收紧网络限制。

黑客人工智能只有按照它的指示去做，仅此而已，才有用。 OpenAI 对此进行了测试，方法是在封闭环境中为模型提供一项艰巨的任务，附近有一些容易破坏的服务。

闯入它们本来可以揭示答案，但它们超出了任务的范围，模型必须自己解决这个问题。在没有安全说明的情况下，GPT-6 Cyber​​ 在 99.93% 的测试中都让他们独自一人，而有了说明，它每次都会这样做。

大多数人暂时无法尝试。 OpenAI 在其安全框架下将该模型归类为网络安全中的“关键”模型，目前只有一小部分经批准的安全团队有权访问。

news.title: Sources: the US SEC is investigating Nvidia, including whether the company's disclosures misled investors (Wall Street Journal)
news.title_en: Sources: the US SEC is investigating Nvidia, including whether the company's disclosures misled investors (Wall Street Journal)
news.author: Wall Street Journal
news.article_content:
The US Securities and Exchange Commission is reportedly investigating whether Nvidia misled investors through its disclosures.

The reported inquiry focuses on Nvidia’s disclosures to investors. The question is whether those statements gave shareholders an accurate picture.

Neither the SEC nor Nvidia has publicly confirmed the inquiry. For now it is a report, not a finding, and it should be read that way.

An investigation is not an accusation. Regulators open inquiries to gather facts, and many end without any charges.

There is no public indication that the agency has started a formal enforcement action. That step would come later, if at all, after investigators finish reviewing documents and interviewing witnesses.

Securities law requires public companies to share information that a reasonable investor would consider important. That covers financial results, business risks, and material developments that could move the share price.

Daily. Free. Join 34,000+ readers across crypto, finance, and policy.

We respect your privacy. Unsubscribe anytime.

The SEC also operates under a lower burden of proof than private plaintiffs. That gives the agency some room that shareholder lawyers do not always have.

If the agency ultimately found violations, its toolkit could include penalties against the company. In serious cases, it can also seek an officer-and-director bar, which prevents an individual from running a public company.

Those outcomes are hypothetical at this stage. They describe what the agency can do, not what it intends to do here.

Nvidia has long faced questions about its most advanced AI chips ending up in China. US export controls restrict sales of high-end chips there, and enforcement has been a recurring policy theme.

Private litigation is another possible ripple effect. Reports of regulatory scrutiny often draw the attention of shareholder law firms, which may look for grounds to file class actions on behalf of investors who bought during a disputed period.

Until more is confirmed, the most accurate description is the plainest one. Nvidia is reportedly under SEC scrutiny over its investor disclosures, and no wrongdoing has been established.

ai_analysis.takeaway_zh: 本轮审查的核心逻辑在于英伟达在应对地缘政治制裁时，其对供应链脆弱性和潜在市场损失的披露是否足以支撑投资人的知情权。若监管证实其在出口限制的影响范围上存在信息“遮掩”，英伟达或面临行政处罚，且可能触发针对其股价波动的各类证券集体诉讼，从而对其极高市场预期背后的溢价形成压力测试。
ai_analysis.takeaway_en: The core of this inquiry lies in whether Nvidia’s disclosures regarding supply chain fragility and market loss under geopolitical sanctions have adequately informed shareholders. Should regulators prove intentional obfuscation of the impact of export controls, the firm risks administrative penalties and shareholder class-action lawsuits, potentially exerting pressure on the valuation premium built upon its aggressive market growth projections.

news.article_content_zh:
美国证券交易委员会正在调查英伟达是否通过其披露信息误导了投资者。

报道的调查重点是英伟达向投资者披露的信息。问题是这些陈述是否让股东了解了准确的情况。

美国证券交易委员会和英伟达都没有公开证实这项调查。目前它只是一份报告，而不是一项发现，应该这样解读。

调查不是指控。监管机构开展调查以收集事实，许多调查最终都没有提出任何指控。

没有公开迹象表明该机构已开始正式执法行动。如果有的话，这一步骤将在调查人员审查完文件并采访证人之后进行。

证券法要求上市公司分享理性投资者认为重要的信息。这涵盖了财务业绩、商业风险以及可能影响股价的重大进展。

我们尊重您的隐私。随时取消订阅。

与私人原告相比，美国证券交易委员会的举证责任也较低。这为该机构提供了一些股东律师并不总是拥有的空间。

如果该机构最终发现违规行为，其工具包可能包括对该公司的处罚。在严重的情况下，它还可以寻求高管和董事资格，以阻止个人经营上市公司。

这些结果在现阶段是假设的。他们描述了该机构可以做什么，而不是它打算在这里做什么。

长期以来，英伟达一直面临着其最先进的人工智能芯片最终进入中国的质疑。美国的出口管制限制了高端芯片在当地的销售，而强制执行一直是反复出现的政策主题。

私人诉讼是另一个可能的连锁反应。监管审查的报告经常引起股东律师事务所的注意，这些律师事务所可能会寻找理由代表在争议期间购买的投资者提起集体诉讼。

在得到更多证实之前，最准确的描述就是最简单的描述。据报道，英伟达正在接受美国证券交易委员会 (SEC) 对其投资者信息披露的审查，目前尚未发现存在任何不当行为。

news.title: Not even Sam Altman is safe from AI deepfakes on Instagram
news.title_en: Not even Sam Altman is safe from AI deepfakes on Instagram

inline_images.caption: Sam Altman Speaks At OpenAI Developers Conference In San Francisco
inline_images.alt: Sam Altman Speaks At OpenAI Developers Conference In San Francisco

news.author: The Verge AI
news.article_content:
Instagram is filled with people posting deepfaked content — including, as of late, from one of Meta’s most prominent executives.

Earlier in November, Alexandr Wang, Meta’s chief AI officer, shared a short clip to promote Muse, the company’s consumer AI agent. In the AI-generated clip, Wang, Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, and Jolly, the anthropomorphic mascot of Muse, are on a four-way video call. When Altman joins the call he’s dressed like Jolly, wearing a furry hooded suit and face paint to look like the cutesy character. The clip is captioned “When the homies meet about openai product strategy,” a reference to the AI agent race and the recent popularity of Muse.

[Media: https://www.instagram.com/p/DffPoRdhozI/]

Just a few years ago, AI content portraying real people led to strong public statements rebuking the use of the technology to imitate humans. In some cases legal action was threatened. Now, AI content has become part of the texture of a new reality, especially on social media. Leading up to the midterm elections, for example, political groups ran millions of dollars’ worth of AI-generated ads attacking opponents.

Wang has been doing a lot of what some have described as “anti-PR” to promote Muse, tweeting hundreds of times and referring to more traditional marketers as “corposlops.” Still, a major tech executive posting an AI video of a competitor is notable, especially on a platform that’s been criticized recently over AI-generated content. After an AI-generated image of actress Mia Goth gained traction in October, the Pearl star’s representative told The Verge it was “incomprehensible” that Instagram allowed the image to spread instead of focusing on the “protection and integrity of a public figure’s likeness.” Other celebrities, including Scarlett Johansson, are regularly the subject of sexualized AI imagery; Meta has removed some accounts in the past that it found to be posing as someone else and using their likeness.

Meta requires AI-generated videos depicting people to be labeled as AI, like Wang’s post is. Static images, however, have no such requirement, meaning the AI image of Goth had no disclosure. To make matters worse, the image was shared by a fan account with a blue verification badge given by Instagram.

Reached for comment, Meta spokesperson Tracy Clayton noted that Wang’s post is labeled as AI content. Clayton also pointed out that Altman has made his likeness available for AI content generation, as when OpenAI launched its Sora app (and it was quickly flooded with fake Altman videos). OpenAI didn’t respond to requests for comment.

news.article_content_zh:
Instagram 上到处都是发布深度造假内容的人，其中包括最近来自 Meta 最著名的高管之一的内容。

11 月初，Meta 首席人工智能官 Alexandr Wang 分享了一段宣传该公司消费者人工智能代理 Muse 的短片。在 AI 生成的视频中，Wang、Meta 首席执行官马克·扎克伯格、OpenAI 首席执行官萨姆·奥尔特曼以及 Muse 的拟人吉祥物 Jolly 正在进行四方视频通话。当奥特曼加入通话时，他穿得像乔利一样，穿着毛茸茸的连帽套装，脸上涂着颜料，看起来就像这个可爱的角色。该剪辑的标题是“当兄弟们见面讨论 openai 产品策略时”，指的是 AI 代理竞赛和 Muse 最近的流行。

就在几年前，描绘真人的人工智能内容引发了强烈的公开声明，谴责使用该技术来模仿人类。在某些情况下，威胁要采取法律行动。现在，人工智能内容已经成为新现实的一部分，尤其是在社交媒体上。例如，在中期选举之前，政治团体投放了价值数百万美元的人工智能生成的广告来攻击对手。

为了推广 Muse，王做了很多被一些人称为“反公关”的事情，他发了数百条推文，并将更传统的营销人员称为“corposlops”。尽管如此，一位主要科技高管发布竞争对手的人工智能视频还是值得注意的，尤其是在一个最近因人工智能生成内容而受到批评的平台上。 10 月份，人工智能生成的女演员米娅·高斯 (Mia Goth) 的一张照片受到关注后，这位珍珠明星的代表告诉 The Verge，Instagram 允许这张照片传播，而不是专注于“公众人物肖像的保护和完整性”，这是“不可理解的”。其他名人，包括斯嘉丽约翰逊，经常成为性感人工智能图像的主题； Meta 过去删除了一些发现冒充他人并使用其肖像的帐户。

Meta 要求人工智能生成的描绘人物的视频被贴上人工智能的标签，就像王的帖子一样。然而静态图像没有这样的要求，这意味着哥特的人工智能图像没有泄露。更糟糕的是，这张图片是由一个带有 Instagram 提供的蓝色验证徽章的粉丝账户分享的。

Meta 发言人特雷西·克莱顿 (Tracy Clayton) 联系我们寻求评论时指出，王的帖子被标记为人工智能内容。克莱顿还指出，奥特曼已经将他的肖像用于人工智能内容生成，就像 OpenAI 推出其 Sora 应用程序时一样（很快就充斥着假奥特曼视频）。 OpenAI 没有回应置评请求。

news.author: THE DECODER
news.article_content:
OpenAI releases two new language models. GPT-6.2 Astra is aimed at demanding professional work, while GPT-6.2 Sol is built for everyday use. OpenAI says both outperform their predecessors on benchmarks and cost less to run.

GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol are available now for Plus, Pro, Enterprise, and Edu users in ChatGPT Work and Codex. Pro-500 subscribers can use Ultrafast mode with both models. For the first time, Pro-200 subscribers also get Ultrafast access, starting with GPT-6.2 Sol.

Developers can access both models through the OpenAI API. OpenAI says API pricing for GPT-6.2 Astra is 20 percent cheaper than its predecessor's, at $8 per million input tokens, $0.40 for cached inputs, and $40 per million output tokens. GPT-6.2 Sol keeps GPT-6.1 Sol's pricing at $2 for input, $0.10 for cached inputs, and $10 for output per million tokens.Ad

OpenAI trained GPT-6.2 Astra to handle professional conventions in fields like law, finance, and accounting more reliably. The company says presentations pull layouts, colors, and typography from templates, matching exact font sizes. Slide titles are meant to capture a slide's main point, while body text stays focused on key details.Ad

OpenAI's announcement leans hard on the price-to-performance ratio of its models. On Agents' Last Exam, a benchmark that tests multi-step professional workflows, GPT-6.2 Astra scores 5.2 points above its predecessor GPT-6 Astra at less than a third of the cost, according to OpenAI. It leads Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 by 5.5 points at just 5 percent of the cost. Only Google's Gemini 4 Carbon keeps up with Astra on this benchmark.

On the legal benchmark Harvey LAB-AA, which covers tasks like contract clause analysis, GPT-6.2 Astra more than doubles Claude Fable 5.2's pass rate at about one-sixth of the cost, according to OpenAI. On the internal GDPval-v2 benchmark, which includes consulting, finance, and design tasks, OpenAI says Astra gains 6.2 percentage points over its predecessor while using 22 percent fewer output tokens.Ad

OpenAI says computer use, already a strong suit of the predecessor, got better again. In testing, the model reportedly built a 3D car model, wrote a physics solver in Python, and animated the results in Blender. In another demo, it modeled a remote-controlled car part by part and produced an animated assembly guide.

OpenAI also claims progress in web design. On the 3D benchmark AA-3D, human judges compare two blinded interactive experiences. GPT-6.2 Astra takes first with 1,318 Elo points, ahead of Claude Fable 5.2 at 1,271 and GPT-6.2 Sol at 1,259.Ad

On Terminal-Bench-Science, a benchmark that tests scientific workflows in a terminal, the model scores 9 percentage points above GPT-6 Astra, again at less than a third of the cost, according to OpenAI. Astra also sets a new high on the Vals Science Index, which measures how well models interpret biological data and run experiments, OpenAI says.Ad

GPT-6.2 Sol is for users who want a fast, versatile model for everyday tasks, OpenAI says. On the coding benchmark FrontierCode 2.0, which checks whether code changes meet the quality bar of real projects, Sol trails Astra by just 0.5 points at one-fifth the cost. OpenAI says the model also handles non-work tasks well.

news.title_zh: OpenAI发布GPT-6.2系列模型并下调API定价
news.summary_zh: OpenAI推出GPT-6.2 Astra与Sol模型，在提升专业任务性能的同时降低了API调用成本
news.article_content_zh:
OpenAI 发布了两种新的语言模型。 GPT-6.2 Astra 旨在满足要求较高的专业工作，而 GPT-6.2 Sol 则适合日常使用。 OpenAI 表示，两者在基准测试中都优于其前辈，而且运行成本更低。

GPT-6.2 Astra 和 Sol 现已可供 ChatGPT Work 和 Codex 中的 Plus、Pro、Enterprise 和 Edu 用户使用。 Pro-500 用户可以在这两种型号上使用超快模式。从 GPT-6.2 Sol 开始，Pro-200 订阅者还首次获得超快访问。

开发人员可以通过 OpenAI API 访问这两个模型。 OpenAI 表示，GPT-6.2 Astra 的 API 定价比其前身便宜 20%，每百万输入代币为 8 美元，缓存输入为 0.40 美元，每百万输出代币为 40 美元。 GPT-6.2 Sol 保持 GPT-6.1 Sol 的输入定价为 2 美元，缓存输入为 0.10 美元，输出为每百万代币 10 美元。

OpenAI 训练了 GPT-6.2 Astra，使其能够更可靠地处理法律、金融和会计等领域的专业惯例。该公司表示，演示文稿从模板中提取布局、颜色和版式，匹配精确的字体大小。幻灯片标题旨在捕捉幻灯片的要点，而正文则重点关注关键细节。

OpenAI 的声明很大程度上依赖于其模型的性价比。据 OpenAI 称，在测试多步骤专业工作流程的 Agents Last Exam 基准测试中，GPT-6.2 Astra 的得分比其前身 GPT-6 Astra 高出 5.2 分，而成本却不到其前身的三分之一。它比 Anthropic 的 Claude Fable 5.2 领先 5.5 个百分点，而成本仅为 Anthropic 的 5%。在这一基准测试中，只有 Google 的 Gemini 4 Carbon 能与 Astra 保持同步。

据 OpenAI 称，在涵盖合同条款分析等任务的法律基准 Harvey LAB-AA 上，GPT-6.2 Astra 的通过率是 Claude Fable 5.2 的两倍多，而成本约为六分之一。 OpenAI 表示，在包括咨询、财务和设计任务在内的内部 GDPval-v2 基准上，Astra 比其前身提高了 6.2 个百分点，同时使用的输出代币减少了 22%。

OpenAI 表示，计算机的使用已经是前身的强项，现在又变得更好了。据报道，在测试中，该模型构建了 3D 汽车模型，用 Python 编写了物理解算器，并在 Blender 中对结果进行了动画处理。在另一个演示中，它对遥控汽车的各个部分进行了建模，并制作了动画装配指南。

OpenAI 还声称在网页设计方面取得了进展。在 3D 基准 AA-3D 上，人类评委比较两种盲态交互体验。 GPT-6.2 Astra 以 1,318 Elo 点位居第一，领先于 Claude Fable 5.2 的 1,271 点和 GPT-6.2 Sol 的 1,259 点。

据 OpenAI 称，在 Terminal-Bench-Science（测试终端中科学工作流程的基准）上，该模型的得分比 GPT-6 Astra 高出 9 个百分点，而成本又不到 GPT-6 Astra 的三分之一。 OpenAI 表示，Astra 还创下了 Vals 科学指数的新高，该指数衡量模型解释生物数据和运行实验的能力。

OpenAI 表示，GPT-6.2 Sol 适合那些想要快速、多功能模型来完成日常任务的用户。在编码基准 FrontierCode 2.0（检查代码更改是否满足实际项目的质量标准）上，Sol 仅落后 Astra 0.5 个百分点，而成本仅为 Astra 的五分之一。 OpenAI 表示，该模型还可以很好地处理非工作任务。

据 OpenAI 称，GPT-6.2 Astra 和 Sol 在网络安全方面也取得了更好的进展。他们更有效地发现和利用漏洞，编写更安全的代码，并提供更好的错误修复，在多项测试中代币效率显着提高。这两种模型都达到了 OpenAI 准备框架中网络安全的“关键”门槛，就像之前的 GPT-6 Astra 一样。

作为回应，OpenAI 正在针对潜在风险的网络安全请求添加更严格的保护措施。 OpenAI 表示，这些保障措施应该会加大滥用的难度，但也会限制合法的漏洞研究和安全测试。

OpenAI 计划通过 OpenAI Daybreak 提供新模型，该模型已经让经过审查的安全研究人员能够访问其他护栏较少的模型。公布的网络安全基准数据来自关闭防护措施和分类器的内部测试。 OpenAI 在随附的安全报告中阐述了其方法。

news.title: Apple's System Status page shows an outage affecting iCloud sign-in for "all users", the App Store, and Apple Music; some users report failed iPhone activations (Sarah Perez/TechCrunch)
news.title_en: Apple's System Status page shows an outage affecting iCloud sign-in for "all users", the App Store, and Apple Music; some users report failed iPhone activations (Sarah Perez/TechCrunch)
news.author: TechCrunch
news.article_content:
After a recent slew of tech outages, service disruptions, and flight chaos this week, now it’s Apple customers who are facing technical issues.

On Reddit, some folks also noted that they were unable to activate a new iPhone, which is likely related to these ongoing issues.

Given the recent increase in AI-driven cyberattacks, users across social media have already begun to speculate about the cause. In particular, users are expressing concerns about the Apple outage, as it arrives only days after technical failures at Microsoft led to its cloud systems that power flagship services like Outlook and Teams failing due to cascading software issues.

Similarly, a brief outage of Chase’s banking app this week garnered attention, as did an ongoing partial outage (at the time of publication) of the National Security Agency’s internal classified network, both of which were blamed on software glitches.

So far, none of the outages in the past week have been attributed to cyberattacks, but rather to technical problems.

Apple has yet to issue any sort of formal statement about the outages, beyond acknowledging via its status page that the issues are occurring. TechCrunch reached out to the company for comment but hasn’t heard back yet — if we do, we will update.

After the initial outages were reported, Apple’s status page was updated to include other outages impacting Apple School Manager, iCloud Mail, iCloud Web Apps (iCloud.com), and Schoolwork.

Post updated after publication with the status of the outages.

When you purchase through links in our articles, we may earn a small commission. This doesn’t affect our editorial independence.

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 此次密集的技术故障暴露了头部科技企业在追求全球化、高并发部署中对底层软件调度系统的过度依赖，任何单一故障点（Single Point of Failure）的级联效应均会对全球业务连续性构成严重威胁。云端生态系统的闭环程度越高，一旦触发服务层异常，其跨地域、跨业务线的同步崩塌将对品牌信用与用户资产安全产生难以估量的负面效应。
ai_analysis.insight_en: These frequent outages reveal an over-reliance on centralized underlying software scheduling systems by hyperscalers, where single points of failure trigger cascading global disruptions. The tighter the integration of cloud ecosystems, the greater the catastrophic risk to brand equity and user asset security when fundamental operational layers suffer synchronization failures.

news.article_content_zh:
本周，在经历了一系列技术中断、服务中断和航班混乱之后，现在面临技术问题的是苹果客户。

在 Reddit 上，一些人还指出他们无法激活新 iPhone，这可能与这些持续存在的问题有关。

鉴于最近人工智能驱动的网络攻击有所增加，社交媒体上的用户已经开始猜测其原因。特别是，用户对苹果的服务中断表示担忧，因为就在几天前，微软的技术故障导致其为 Outlook 和 Teams 等旗舰服务提供支持的云系统因级联软件问题而出现故障。

同样，本周大通银行应用程序的短暂中断引起了人们的关注，国家安全局内部机密网络的持续部分中断（截至本文发布时）也引起了人们的关注，这两起事件都被归咎于软件故障。

到目前为止，过去一周的中断都不是由网络攻击造成的，而是由技术问题造成的。

除了通过其状态页面承认问题正在发生之外，苹果尚未就此次中断发表任何形式的正式声明。 TechCrunch 联系该公司征求意见，但尚未收到回复——如果收到，我们会更新。

news.title: Google updates Gemini Privacy Hub to extend its retention period for temporary chats and chats with history turned off from 72 hours to around two months (Jagmeet Singh/TechCrunch)
news.title_en: Google updates Gemini Privacy Hub to extend its retention period for temporary chats and chats with history turned off from 72 hours to around two months (Jagmeet Singh/TechCrunch)
news.author: TechCrunch
news.article_content:
Google is extending how long it keeps temporary Gemini chats and conversations made with chat history turned off to around two months, saying the change aims to improve safety and security as AI systems become more capable.

The change, which will roll out globally in the Gemini app over the coming weeks, marks a significant increase from the previous 72-hour retention period mentioned in Google’s Gemini Apps Privacy Hub, according to an archived version from November 12.

OpenAI, by comparison, says it may keep temporary chats in ChatGPT for up to 30 days, whereas Anthropic retains incognito chats in Claude for 30 days by default. However, companies may keep some data longer for legal or safety reasons, or to investigate policy violations.

Google did not answer questions about what prompted the change and whether it would affect how conversations are accessed or reviewed, instead pointing to a blog post that says chats are kept longer to respond to users, process feedback, and protect its services and users. Its updated Gemini Apps Privacy Hub also cites potential system failures as a reason for retaining chats and says temporary conversations are not used to train AI models.

The longer retention period comes as Google introduces separate settings for Gemini’s chat history and AI training. Until now, both were tied to a single “Keep Activity” setting. Users will now be able to keep their conversations in their chat history without using them to train Google’s generative AI models.

Google says both new settings will be turned off by default for users who previously disabled Keep Activity. For those who had Keep Activity turned on, their chat history will remain enabled. They can, though, decide separately whether Google can use their conversations to train AI models.

news.article_content_zh:
谷歌将临时 Gemini 聊天和关闭聊天记录的对话的保留时间延长至两个月左右，并表示这一变化旨在随着人工智能系统变得更加强大，提高安全性。

根据 11 月 12 日的存档版本，这一变化将在未来几周内在 Gemini 应用程序中在全球范围内推出，这标志着 Google Gemini 应用程序隐私中心提到的之前 72 小时保留期的显着增加。

相比之下，OpenAI 表示，它可能会在 ChatGPT 中保留临时聊天最多 30 天，而 Anthropic 默认情况下会在 Claude 中保留隐身聊天 30 天。然而，出于法律或安全原因，或者为了调查政策违规行为，公司可能会将某些数据保留更长时间。

谷歌没有回答有关促成这一变化的原因以及它是否会影响对话的访问或审查方式的问题，而是指出一篇博客文章称，聊天会保留更长时间，以响应用户、处理反馈并保护其服务和用户。其更新的 Gemini Apps Privacy Hub 也将潜在的系统故障作为保留聊天的原因，并表示临时对话不用于训练人工智能模型。

随着谷歌为Gemini的聊天记录和人工智能训练引入了单独的设置，保留时间更长了。到目前为止，两者都绑定到一个单一的“保持活动”设置。用户现在可以将他们的对话保存在聊天记录中，而无需使用它们来训练b谷歌的生成式人工智能模型。

谷歌表示，对于之前禁用“保持活动”的用户，这两项新设置将默认关闭。对于那些打开了“保持活动”的人，他们的聊天记录将保持启用状态。不过，他们可以单独决定谷歌是否可以利用他们的对话来训练人工智能模型。

news.title: Google’s Spark AI agent becomes ‘Tasks’ — and now it’s free
news.title_en: Google’s Spark AI agent becomes ‘Tasks’ — and now it’s free
news.author: The Verge AI
news.article_content:
Google is rebranding its Spark AI agent as “Tasks” and making it free to use. The feature, which is powered by Google’s new Gemini 4 Hydrogen AI model, can do things like create meal plans, manage your calendar, and dig through your emails to find recurring expenses you might not need.

Google first introduced its Spark AI agent in May, but it was only available to Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers. The launch of tasks in Gemini brings Spark’s capabilities to all users in the US, Canada, Japan, Korea, Australia, and India. You can find tasks by opening Gemini and changing the toggle on the homepage from “Chat” to “Tasks.”

Tasks in Gemini is just one of the many agentic AI features that have emerged over the past year, including Claude Duet, OpenAI’s Dots, and Meta’s Muse. Google says Gemini will perform tasks in a “hardware-isolated virtual machine that’s dedicated to your account and never shared with other users.” You can also provide instructions for Gemini while it completes tasks. When performing more sensitive tasks, like purchasing an item, it will stop working and ask for your permission before following through.

news.article_content:
The most fascinating and frustrating device I've used in a long time pushes at the edges of where headsets are heading, and glasses are evolving.

Let me tell you about a strange, fascinating and rough tweener product called Xreal Aura.

There are VR headsets, and there are smart glasses. And there’s a new class of devices that’s falling right in between. What do we call these things? I have no idea. The category includes the Meta VR Glasses coming next year and now the Aura, a collaboration by Google and Xreal.

The Xreal Aura shoots for the moon, aiming to bridge glasses and VR, and to shrink everything down on the go. It’s often fascinating, and more often frustrating. At times, it almost feels like a VR headset. At other times it feels like a superpowered version of the tethered display glasses that Xreal and several others already make, that act like wearable monitors for your phone or laptop or almost anything else.

I think it’s actually an experimental bridge to a future where phones will play nicer with advanced smart glasses. Those future glasses could create floating displays and workspaces all around you, if you wish. Consider the Aura, in a way, Google’s early attempt to get there.

Emphasis on early. Right now, the Xreal Aura’s features, OS and especially inputs feel rough to use at times and sometimes hard to get into a natural flow with. But it shows what something of this size could be capable of with more software and input-flow tweaks. And when it does work, it feels wildly like a portable VR/AR headset in a way I’ve never really seen before.

The Aura aspires to be a shrunk-down version of last year’s Samsung Galaxy XR, an expensive mixed-reality headset similar to Apple’s Vision Pro. Like the Galaxy XR, the Aura runs Android XR, a variant of Android that floats apps all around. It even runs VR apps. At times it gets close. Other times, it’s not nearly close enough.

What’s wild about the Aura is that it folds down into a case that’s truly small enough to slide into my bag. But setting up and using the Aura often involves patience and experimentation. When it works, it’s a heck of a peek at a future that’s likely around the corner. But the hoops you have to jump through to make it happen sometimes make me want to hop out.

Android XR is Google’s OS for AR/VR/AI devices and wearables, and aims to connect glasses and headsets of all shapes and sizes to Google and Gemini services and apps. The Samsung Galaxy XR, released last year, was the first. Coming up next, in just a few weeks, are Google and Samsung’s Warby Parker- and Gentle Monster-designed AI smart glasses.

The Xreal Aura is more Galaxy XR than smart glasses, in concept: It’s an AR/VR headset that you can take on the go. The glasses connect with a USB-C cable to an included processor puck that runs Android XR. It can display Android apps in both 2D and immersive 3D.

The Aura supports hand tracking and can allow full spatial movement to place floating 3D objects or play immersive games. It can float apps all around you, and you can navigate apps at the same time. You can use hand tracking to open or tap those apps, or a trackpad that’s built into the top of the processor puck. You can also pair a Bluetooth keyboard, or game controller, or a mouse, like I’m doing.

The kit tucks into an included carry case that’s smaller than the one I carry my Nintendo Switch 2 in. It’s easy to pack away for travel. I love this part of the Aura so, so much.

news.article_content_zh:
我长期以来使用过的最令人着迷和令人沮丧的设备推动了耳机发展的边缘，眼镜也在不断发展。

让我告诉你一个奇怪的、迷人的、粗糙的中间产品，叫做 Xreal Aura。

有VR耳机，也有智能眼镜。还有一类新的设备正好介于两者之间。我们怎么称呼这些东西呢？我不知道。该类别包括明年推出的 Meta VR 眼镜，以及现在由 Google 和 Xreal 合作推出的 Aura。

Xreal Aura 瞄准月球，旨在架起眼镜和 VR 的桥梁，并在旅途中缩小一切。它常常令人着迷，但更多时候却令人沮丧。有时，它感觉就像是一个 VR 耳机。有时，它感觉就像是 Xreal 和其他几家公司已经制造的系留显示眼镜的超级版本，就像手机、笔记本电脑或几乎任何其他设备的可穿戴显示器。

我认为这实际上是通向未来的实验桥梁，未来手机将与先进的智能眼镜一起更好地发挥作用。如果您愿意，这些未来的眼镜可以在您周围创建浮动显示器和工作空间。从某种程度上来说，Aura 是谷歌实现这一目标的早期尝试。

强调早。目前，Xreal Aura 的功能、操作系统，尤其是输入有时感觉很难使用，有时很难进入自然流程。但它展示了这种规模的东西可以通过更多软件和输入流调整来实现。当它真正发挥作用时，它给人的感觉就像是一款我从未真正见过的便携式 VR/AR 耳机。

Aura 渴望成为去年三星 Galaxy XR 的缩小版，这是一款类似于苹果 Vision Pro 的昂贵混合现实耳机。与 Galaxy XR 一样，Aura 运行 Android XR，这是 Android 的一个变体，可以在各处浮动应用程序。它甚至可以运行 VR 应用程序。有时它会接近。其他时候，它还不够接近。

Aura 的神奇之处在于，它可以折叠成一个真正小到足以滑入我的包里的盒子。但设置和使用 Aura 通常需要耐心和实验。当它发挥作用时，我们就能看到可能即将到来的未来。但为了实现这一目标，你必须跨越重重障碍，有时让我想跳出去。

Android XR 是谷歌针对 AR/VR/AI 设备和可穿戴设备的操作系统，旨在将各种形状和尺寸的眼镜和耳机连接到谷歌和 Gemini 服务和应用程序。去年发布的三星 Galaxy XR 是第一款。接下来，几周后，谷歌和三星将推出由 Warby Parker 和 Gentle Monster 设计的人工智能智能眼镜。

从概念上讲，Xreal Aura 更像 Galaxy XR，而不是智能眼镜：它是一款可以随身携带的 AR/VR 耳机。该眼镜通过 USB-C 电缆连接到运行 Android XR 的随附处理器盘。它可以以 2D 和沉浸式 3D 方式显示 Android 应用程序。

Aura 支持手部追踪，可以允许完整的空间移动来放置浮动 3D 物体或玩沉浸式游戏。它可以让应用程序漂浮在您周围，并且您可以同时导航应用程序。您可以使用手部跟踪来打开或点击这些应用程序，或者使用处理器圆盘顶部内置的触控板。您还可以像我一样配对蓝牙键盘、游戏控制器或鼠标。

该套件可放入附带的手提箱中，该手提箱比我携带 Nintendo Switch 2 的手提箱还要小。旅行时很容易打包。我非常非常喜欢光环的这一部分。

256GB 存储和 12GB RAM 版本的售价为 1,279 美元，512GB/16GB 版本的售价为 1,499 美元，但它的售价为 1,099 美元/1,299 美元，直到今年年底。不过，板载存储空间就是您所拥有的一切。没有可扩展的 microSD 卡插槽。我评测的是256GB版本。

Aura 中的显示技术是 Xreal 其他系留显示眼镜上现有技术的增强版本，与 Viture 和 TCL RayNeo 使用的技术类似。双微型 OLED 显示屏非常明亮、清晰，通过棱镜投射，看起来就像漂浮在您的房间里一样。 “鸟浴”显示技术意味着镜片厚实且看起来很奇怪，但它们也比 Meta 的 Ray-Ban Displays 等支持显示的无线眼镜更大、更好看。

news.title: Microsoft unveils six AI models spanning coding, cybersecurity, images, and voice, saying MAI Code 2 has 98% of GPT-6.1 Sol's performance at 40% of the price (Ina Fried/Axios)

news.author: Axios
news.article_content:
Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman tells Axios the software giant is making significant progress toward building its own frontier general-purpose AI model, even as it introduces six specialized models that it claims rival leading offerings from OpenAI and Anthropic at a fraction of the cost.

Why it matters: Microsoft has long relied on OpenAI and other AI companies for its most advanced models. Now it's demonstrating that it can develop competitive technology of its own, and the new offerings show how aggressively the tech giant plans to compete on price.

Driving the news: Microsoft is announcing six new AI models Tuesday at its Ignite conference in San Francisco. The models span coding, cybersecurity, image generation and voice.

OpenAI is releasing new models, including Astra and Sol 6.2, which

Between the lines: Microsoft's strategy is to build models specialized for particular tasks, allowing them to achieve comparable performance at significantly lower costs.

"It basically means that you cram more tokens and knowledge and expertise into the same amount of parameters," Suleyman told Axios.

The big picture: Even as Microsoft targets the industry's leaders, frontier AI keeps moving forward as well. OpenAI on Tuesday announced GPT‑6.2 Astra and GPT‑6.2 Sol, with the new Astra priced 20 percent less than the prior version.

The intrigue: The new models could reshape Microsoft's relationship with OpenAI and other outside AI providers.

Zoom in: Microsoft is also offering enterprise customers access to licensed model weights, allowing them to customize its models with proprietary data while requiring deployment within Azure.

What to watch: How quickly Microsoft can translate its progress in specialized AI into a competitive general-purpose model — and whether its cost advantages are enough to persuade customers to switch from established rivals.

ai_analysis.takeaway_zh: 此举标志着微软正从单纯的算力租赁方与AI应用集成商，转型为底层模型架构的自研参与者，通过“垂直模型+Azure云环境”的绑定策略，实质上是在削弱OpenAI模型的不可替代性。将模型权重授权与Azure平台绑定，既能保持数据合规与安全护城河，又能通过成本结构重塑，构建独立于大模型的差异化商业闭环。
ai_analysis.takeaway_en: This move signals Microsoft's strategic pivot from a compute provider to an in-house model architect, effectively commoditizing OpenAI's flagship offerings through vertical specialization. By anchoring licensed model weights within the Azure ecosystem, Microsoft is tightening its vendor lock-in strategy while leveraging cost efficiency to disrupt the broader foundation model market.

news.article_content:
OpenAI kicked off the GPT-6 generation with Astra in September, then upgraded Sol to GPT-6.1 a few weeks later at DevDay.

Today, GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol are coming to ChatGPT Work and Codex together. OpenAI says both can finish demanding tasks with fewer output tokens, so you can get more done before hitting your usage limit.

Astra is still the model OpenAI recommends for your hardest projects.

Say you have a screenshot of a slide and want the rest of your presentation to look like it. OpenAI says GPT-6.2 Astra can use that screenshot as a template and match the layout, colors, and even the font size.

On the Codex side, OpenAI says Astra is better at making and testing changes in an existing project.

“Early testers reported cleaner code style and more focused tests, with fewer rounds of revision,” OpenAI says.

Sol is the more affordable model for everyday coding and writing, and it gets surprisingly close to Astra on one coding test.

Cognition’s FrontierCode 2.0 measures whether changes to real codebases are good enough for maintainers to merge.

With both models at maximum reasoning effort, OpenAI says Sol came within half a point of Astra at about one-fifth the cost.

Some of you have been asking very politely. Some of you have just been asking.GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol are now available.Super efficient and built to perform where it counts—the real world. pic.twitter.com/jLCyVIws2Y

Both models are available starting today in ChatGPT Work and Codex on Plus, Pro, Enterprise, and Edu.

The $200/month Pro plan also gets Ultrafast mode for the first time with Sol. The $500/month Pro plan gets Ultrafast on both models, as do eligible Enterprise and Edu workspaces once an admin enables it.

How fast is Ultrafast? OpenAI says it can generate tokens at up to 4.5 times the standard rate on either model, although it uses more of your allowance. You can switch speeds from the model picker.

Developers can use both models through the API today as well. Astra’s standard input and output prices are 20% lower than with GPT-6 Astra, while Sol keeps its GPT-6.1 pricing. You can read more in OpenAI’s full announcement.

FTC: We use income earning auto affiliate links. More.

Zac Hall is a Senior Editor, covering Apple, apps, and AI. He joined 9to5Mac in 2013.

news.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.2 Astra, its new frontier model for "complex professional work", and GPT-6.2 Sol, its new "go-to model for everyday work" (OpenAI)

news.author: OpenAI
news.article_content:
We’re introducing GPT‑6.2 Astra, our new frontier model for your hardest projects, and GPT‑6.2 Sol, our efficient, versatile model for everyday work. Both models deliver better results on demanding tasks with fewer output tokens, so you can get more done within your usage limits. For businesses and developers, that means frontier performance at costs that make sense at scale.

GPT‑6.2 Astra sets a new quality bar for AI in complex professional work. Its slides, spreadsheets, and documents read less like AI, and more closely follow the templates you provide and the conventions of your field. It writes cleaner code and builds frontends that look and work better, particularly for websites, gaming, and 3D design.

On Agents’ Last Exam, which tests multistep professional work, GPT‑6.2 Astra sets a new high, scoring 5.2 points higher than GPT‑6 Astra at less than a third of the cost, and 5.5 points ahead of Claude Fable 5.2 at just 5% of the cost.

Agents’ Last Exam evaluates models on long-horizon professional workflows. Its leaderboard results for Fable 5.2 exclude nine tasks that used a fallback model.

We believe GPT-6.2 Astra is the best model in the world for scientists. It sets a new high on Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1, which tests how well models can carry out scientific work in a terminal. GPT-6.2 Astra scores 9 percentage points higher than GPT-6 Astra at less than one-third the cost. It also sets a new high on the Vals Science Index, which asks models to interpret real biological data and run experiments to infer how a simulated system works.

In the API, GPT‑6.2 Astra’s input and output token prices are 20% lower than GPT‑6 Astra’s, with a 60% discount on cached input ($8 for input, $0.40 for cached input, and $40 for output, all per million tokens). GPT‑6.2 Sol keeps GPT‑6.1 Sol’s API token prices. On several benchmarks, both models come close to or outperform other leading models at a small fraction of the cost per task.

Compared with GPT‑6.1 Sol, GPT‑6.2 Sol is smarter, more efficient, and lets you complete more tasks on the same paid plan. It powers through multistep agentic workflows, writes clearly and naturally, and is intuitive to collaborate with. Many employees at OpenAI use it as their default model for both technical and non-technical tasks.

In Cognition’s FrontierCode 2.0, GPT‑6.2 Sol comes within 0.5 points of GPT‑6.2 Astra at about one-fifth the cost (both at max).

FrontierCode 2.0 evaluates whether changes to real codebases meet maintainers’ standards for merging.

Its speed and intelligence also make it ideal for the important tasks people turn to AI for outside of work. On our recently released LifeVal⁠ evaluation, which measures performance on challenging everyday tasks, GPT‑6.2 Sol outscores GPT‑6 Astra at about one-seventh the cost.

LifeVal tests how well models handle everyday tasks tailored to someone’s needs, such as shortlisting kindergartens after a move, finding a home that fits a family’s budget and commute, or planning meals for a parent adjusting to a new diagnosis.

We trained GPT‑6.2 Astra to create clearer, better-designed slides, spreadsheets, and documents that more closely follow the conventions professionals use in fields like law, sales, finance, and accounting. The writing is more direct and specific, with fewer generic takeaways and less filler.

news.article_content_zh:
我们推出了 GPT-6.2 Astra，这是我们为您最困难的项目设计的新前沿模型，以及 GPT-6.2 Sol，我们为日常工作设计的高效、多功能模型。两种模型都能以更少的输出令牌在要求较高的任务上提供更好的结果，因此您可以在使用限制内完成更多工作。对于企业和开发人员来说，这意味着以规模化的成本实现前沿性能。

GPT-6.2 Astra 为复杂专业工作中的人工智能设定了新的质量标准。它的幻灯片、电子表格和文档读起来不太像人工智能，而是更严格地遵循您提供的模板和您所在领域的惯例。它编写更清晰的代码并构建外观和工作效果更好的前端，特别是对于网站、游戏和 3D 设计。

在测试多步骤专业工作的 Agents’ Last Exam 中，GPT-6.2 Astra 创下了新高，比 GPT-6 Astra 高出 5.2 分，而成本却不到 GPT-6 Astra 的三分之一，比 Claude Fable 5.2 领先 5.5 分，而成本仅为 GPT-6 Astra 的 5%。

代理商的最后考试评估长期专业工作流程的模型。 《神鬼寓言 5.2》的排行榜结果排除了使用后备模型的九项任务。

我们相信 GPT-6.2 Astra 对于科学家来说是世界上最好的模型。它为 Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 设定了新的高度，该版本测试模型在终端中执行科学工作的能力。 GPT-6.2 Astra 的得分比 GPT-6 Astra 高 9 个百分点，而成本却不到 GPT-6 Astra 的三分之一。它还创下了 Vals 科学指数的新高，该指数要求模型解释真实的生物数据并进行实验以推断模拟系统的工作原理。

在 API 中，GPT-6.2 Astra 的输入和输出代币价格比 GPT-6 Astra 低 20%，缓存输入有 60% 的折扣（输入 8 美元，缓存输入 0.40 美元，输出 40 美元，均为每百万代币）。 GPT-6.2 Sol 保留 GPT-6.1 Sol 的 API 代币价格。在多个基准测试中，这两种模型都接近或优于其他领先模型，而每项任务的成本仅为其一小部分。

与 GPT-6.1 Sol 相比，GPT-6.2 Sol 更智能、更高效，让您在相同的付费套餐中完成更多任务。它通过多步骤代理工作流程提供支持，书写清晰自然，并且协作直观。 OpenAI 的许多员工都将其用作技术和非技术任务的默认模型。

在 Cognition 的 FrontierCode 2.0 中，GPT-6.2 Sol 与 GPT-6.2 Astra 相差不到 0.5 个点，成本约为 GPT-6.2 Astra 的五分之一（均为最大值）。

FrontierCode 2.0 评估对实际代码库的更改是否满足维护者的合并标准。

它的速度和智能也使其成为人们在工作之外求助于人工智能的重要任务的理想选择。在我们最近发布的 LifeVal⁠ 评估（衡量具有挑战性的日常任务的性能）中，GPT-6.2 Sol 的得分超过了 GPT-6 Astra，而成本仅为 GPT-6 Astra 的七分之一左右。

LifeVal 测试模型处理根据某人需求定制的日常任务的能力，例如搬家后筛选幼儿园、寻找适合家庭预算和通勤的房屋，或者为适应新诊断的父母计划膳食。

我们训练 GPT-6.2 Astra 创建更清晰、设计更好的幻灯片、电子表格和文档，更严格地遵循专业人士在法律、销售、财务和会计等领域使用的惯例。写作更加直接和具体，一般性要点和填充物更少。

Harvey LAB-AA v1.1 使用法律作业来测试模型是否可以在源文档中找到相关事实，将其应用到详细的摘要中，并生成满足每项要求的准确交付成果。 GPT-6.2 Astra 树立了新的技术水平，以大约六分之一的成本将 Claude Fable 5.2 的通过率提高了一倍以上。 Astra for Law⁠，我们为律师配置的 GPT-6.2 Astra，在此基准测试中得分甚至更高。

Harvey LAB-AA 测试法律工作，例如审查合同条款。只有当交付成果满足所有评分标准并且不包含任何实质性幻觉时，其标题分数才会给予认可。

news.title: Hydropower hit record lows in the US Southwest this summer
news.title_en: Hydropower hit record lows in the US Southwest this summer

inline_images.caption: aerial view of Horseshoe Bend on the Colorado River in July of 2026 showing low water levels
inline_images.alt: aerial view of Horseshoe Bend on the Colorado River in July of 2026 showing low water levels

news.author: MIT Tech Review
news.article_content:
The US Southwest generated 28% less electricity via hydropower between April and August than the 10-year average, according to new data from the US Energy Information Administration.

Most hydropower plants in the US rely on dams to hold back water, creating reservoirs. The water can be released through turbines, generating electricity on demand. But an extreme, prolonged drought in the Colorado River Basin has resulted in dangerously low water levels in the Southwest’s two largest reservoirs, affecting the availability of this power source.

Residents and farmers in the US Southwest, a region that includes Arizona, New Mexico, and parts of Nevada and California, rely on water that melts in the spring from snowpack in the mountains and is slowly allowed to flow south via dam releases. Snowfall in the Rocky Mountains provides about 85% of the annual flow of the Colorado River. And in recent years, the river has seen record-low flows.

Two reservoirs along the Colorado River, Lake Powell and Lake Mead, have struggled to stay above the minimum level required for hydropower plants. At the end of September, Lake Powell’s depth was 3,518 feet, less than 1% above the level required to run the water through turbines that produce electricity at the Glen Canyon power plant. The Hoover Dam power plant requires 950 feet in Lake Mead, and that reservoir was 9% above the minimum in September.

Together, the two plants produced nearly seven terawatt-hours of electricity in 2025, enough to serve over 2 million people.

Low water levels have been an ongoing struggle for the region, which has been in a drought for 27 years. Meanwhile, climate change is continuing to shift rainfall and snowfall patterns across the region and around the world.

The effects of climate change on hydropower aren’t entirely straightforward globally—some regions will see more rain and snow because of shifting weather patterns, while others are likely to see less.

But it’s playing a role for hydropower availability, according to one 2022 review study. Rising temperatures bring more droughts, warmer winters means less snow and ice to fill the reservoirs, and more variability in precipitation can lead to alternating floods and droughts, making the power source less reliable.

Hydropower production is likely to be at its lowest level in over a decade in 2026 and tick even lower in 2027, according to projections from the EIA.

El Niño could provide some temporary relief. Sometimes this weather pattern can mean cooler, wetter conditions for the southern US. Heavy rains brought floods to the region in October and early November, and the water levels in Lake Powell rose more than 20 feet from their mid-September low. But the water is still quite low, and it’ll take much more to help reservoirs recover from decades of drought conditions.

Even as a changing climate complicates the availability of hydropower, the decline in capacity could push greenhouse-gas emissions higher. In 2023, energy-related greenhouse-gas emissions rose by 1.1% globally. A worldwide shortfall in hydropower generation accounted for about 40% of that rise, according to a report from the International Energy Agency.

news.article_content_zh:
美国能源情报署的最新数据显示，4 月至 8 月期间，美国西南部的水力发电量比 10 年平均水平减少了 28%。

美国大多数水力发电厂都依靠水坝来蓄水，形成水库。水可以通过涡轮机释放，按需发电。但科罗拉多河流域的极端长期干旱导致西南部两个最大的水库水位处于危险的低水平，影响了该电源的可用性。

美国西南部地区（包括亚利桑那州、新墨西哥州、内华达州和加利福尼亚州的部分地区）的居民和农民依赖于春季山区积雪融化的水，然后通过大坝泄洪缓慢向南流动。落基山脉的降雪提供了科罗拉多河年流量的约 85%。近年来，这条河的流量创历史新低。

科罗拉多河沿岸的两个水库——鲍威尔湖和米德湖——一直在努力保持在水电站所需的最低水位以上。截至 9 月底，鲍威尔湖的深度为 3,518 英尺，仅比格伦峡谷发电厂涡轮机发电所需水位高出不到 1%。胡佛水坝发电厂需要米德湖 950 英尺的水位，而该水库比 9 月份的最低水位高出 9%。

到 2025 年，这两座发电厂总共可生产近 7 太瓦时的电力，足以为超过 200 万人提供服务。

该地区已经经历了 27 年的干旱，低水位一直困扰着该地区。与此同时，气候变化正在继续改变该地区和世界各地的降雨和降雪模式。

气候变化对水力发电的影响在全球范围内并不完全是直接的——由于天气模式的变化，一些地区会出现更多的雨雪，而另一些地区的雨雪可能会减少。

但根据 2022 年的一项回顾研究，它在水力发电方面发挥着重要作用。气温上升会带来更多的干旱，温暖的冬季意味着水库中的冰雪减少，而降水的变化更大可能导致洪水和干旱交替出现，从而使电力来源变得不那么可靠。

根据 EIA 的预测，2026 年水电产量可能会达到十多年来的最低水平，2027 年甚至更低。

厄尔尼诺现象可以提供一些暂时的缓解。有时，这种天气模式可能意味着美国南部的天气更加凉爽、湿润。 10月和11月初的大雨给该地区带来了洪水，鲍威尔湖的水位比9月中旬的低点上涨了20多英尺。但水位仍然很低，需要更多的努力才能帮助水库从数十年的干旱中恢复过来。

尽管气候变化使水力发电的可用性变得更加复杂，但容量的下降可能会导致温室气体排放量上升。 2023年，全球与能源相关的温室气体排放量增加了1.1%。国际能源署的一份报告显示，全球水力发电量的短缺约占发电量增长的 40%。

这些科学家希望火灾探测卫星、人工智能工具和古老的土地实践能够保护世界上脆弱的永久冻土及其储存的大量碳。

新技术可以帮助减少电力损失并重塑电网的主要部分。

将液体电解质换成固体材料的电池有望充电更快、使用寿命更长，并且（至关重要的是）运行温度更低。

news.title: An interview with OpenAI President Greg Brockman, who says he is in "full management mode", as he focuses on corporate customers and tools for cybersecurity (Jemima McEvoy/The Information)
news.title_en: An interview with OpenAI President Greg Brockman, who says he is in "full management mode", as he focuses on corporate customers and tools for cybersecurity (Jemima McEvoy/The Information)
news.author: The Information
news.article_content:
President Claudia Sheinbaum met on Wednesday with Greg Brockman, president and co-founder of OpenAI, the San Francisco-based company that created ChatGPT.

“At the National Palace, we welcomed OpenAI’s president and co-founder Greg Brockman and his team,” Sheinbaum wrote on social media.

En Palacio Nacional, recibimos al presidente y cofundador de OpenAI, Greg Brockman, y a su equipo; conversamos sobre las diversas aplicaciones de la inteligencia artificial, particularmente en el sector Salud.

Coincidimos en que esta tecnología puede generar beneficios en atención médica.

“We discussed the various applications of artificial intelligence, particularly in the healthcare sector. We agreed that this technology can bring benefits to healthcare,” she wrote.

Sheinbaum’s meeting with Brockman came a few weeks after the federal government announced the establishment of an Advisory Council for the Digital Transformation of the Health Sector, which is aimed at improving the control, storage and distribution of medications.

Members of the council will use digital tools and artificial intelligence (AI) to detect medication shortages — a long-running problem in Mexico — track warehouse inventory and expedite delivery to public hospitals and health centers.

There was no indication from Sheinbaum that OpenAI is going to collaborate withe the council in any way.

However, it is clear that the federal government is seeking to use AI as a means to improve healthcare in Mexico.

At her Thursday morning press conference, Sheinbaum told reporters that her government is interested in collaborating with China on “different issues,” one of which is “smart hospitals.”

“We’re very interested in the smart hospitals they have in China,” she said ahead of her trip to Shenzhen to attend the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation Leaders’ Meeting.

“… [We want to] implement this model in our country,” Sheinbaum said.

A smart hospital is a healthcare facility that uses a range of technology, including AI, to automate certain tasks and improve patient care.

The president is not the only Mexican official to have met with an OpenAI executive. Economy Minister Marcelo Ebrard met OpenAI CEO Sam Altman in the United States in early September. Jensen Huang, who resigned as CEO of chipmaker Nvidia on Thursday, and Tom Brown, co-founder of the AI company Anthropic, also met Ebrard at a G20 meeting in North Carolina.

According to the Economy Ministry, Ebrard said at the time that “Mexico must develop its capabilities in AI, given that the impact AI will have on the economy is as disruptive as the impact the advent of electricity once had on manufacturing.”

The president is not the only Mexican official to have met with an OpenAI executive. Economy Minister Marcelo Ebrard met OpenAI CEO Sam Altman in the United States in early September. Jensen Huang, who resigned as CEO of chipmaker Nvidia on Thursday, and Tom Brown, co-founder of the AI company Anthropic, also met Ebrard at a G20 meeting in North Carolina.

According to the Economy Ministry, Ebrard said at the time that “Mexico must develop its capabilities in AI, given that the impact AI will have on the economy is as disruptive as the impact the advent of electricity once had on manufacturing.”

news.article_content_zh:
周三，总裁 Claudia Sheinbaum 会见了 OpenAI 的总裁兼联合创始人格雷格·布罗克曼 (Greg Brockman)，OpenAI 是一家总部位于旧金山的公司，ChatGPT 的创建者。

“在故宫，我们迎来了 OpenAI 总裁兼联合创始人 Greg Brockman 和他的团队，”Sheinbaum 在社交媒体上写道。

国家宫 (Palacio Nacional) 主席兼 OpenAI 联合创始人 Greg Brockman 是您的设备；与人工智能、特殊领域健康领域的多种应用相关。

“我们讨论了人工智能的各种应用，特别是在医疗保健领域。我们一致认为这项技术可以给医疗保健带来好处，”她写道。

希恩鲍姆与布罗克曼的会面是在联邦政府宣布成立卫生部门数字化转型咨询委员会几周后进行的，该委员会旨在改善药物的控制、储存和分配。

该委员会成员将使用数字工具和人工智能（AI）来检测药品短缺（墨西哥长期存在的问题），跟踪仓库库存并加快向公立医院和医疗中心的交付。

Sheinbaum 没有表示 OpenAI 将以任何方式与该委员会合作。

然而，很明显，联邦政府正在寻求利用人工智能来改善墨西哥的医疗保健。

在周四上午的新闻发布会上，谢因鲍姆告诉记者，她的政府有兴趣在“不同问题”上与中国合作，其中之一就是“智能医院”。

“我们对中国的智慧医院非常感兴趣，”她在前往深圳参加亚太经合组织领导人会议之前说道。

“……[我们希望]在我们国家实施这种模式，”谢因鲍姆说。

智能医院是一家医疗机构，它使用包括人工智能在内的一系列技术来自动执行某些任务并改善患者护理。

总统并不是唯一一位会见 OpenAI 高管的墨西哥官员。 9月初，经济部长Marcelo Ebrard在美国会见了OpenAI首席执行官Sam Altman。周四辞去芯片制造商英伟达首席执行官职务的黄仁勋和人工智能公司 Anthropic 联合创始人汤姆·布朗也在北卡罗来纳州举行的 G20 会议上会见了埃布拉德。

news.title: Introducing GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
news.title_en: Introducing GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
news.author: OpenAI 官方动态
news.article_content:
We’re introducing GPT‑6.2 Astra, our new frontier model for your hardest projects, and GPT‑6.2 Sol, our efficient, versatile model for everyday work. Both models deliver better results on demanding tasks with fewer output tokens, so you can get more done within your usage limits. For businesses and developers, that means frontier performance at costs that make sense at scale.

GPT‑6.2 Astra sets a new quality bar for AI in complex professional work. Its slides, spreadsheets, and documents read less like AI, and more closely follow the templates you provide and the conventions of your field. It writes cleaner code and builds frontends that look and work better, particularly for websites, gaming, and 3D design.

On Agents’ Last Exam, which tests multistep professional work, GPT‑6.2 Astra sets a new high, scoring 5.2 points higher than GPT‑6 Astra at less than a third of the cost, and 5.5 points ahead of Claude Fable 5.2 at just 5% of the cost.

Agents’ Last Exam evaluates models on long-horizon professional workflows. Its leaderboard results for Fable 5.2 exclude nine tasks that used a fallback model.

We believe GPT-6.2 Astra is the best model in the world for scientists. It sets a new high on Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1, which tests how well models can carry out scientific work in a terminal. GPT-6.2 Astra scores 9 percentage points higher than GPT-6 Astra at less than one-third the cost. It also sets a new high on the Vals Science Index, which asks models to interpret real biological data and run experiments to infer how a simulated system works.

In the API, GPT‑6.2 Astra’s input and output token prices are 20% lower than GPT‑6 Astra’s, with a 60% discount on cached input ($8 for input, $0.40 for cached input, and $40 for output, all per million tokens). GPT‑6.2 Sol keeps GPT‑6.1 Sol’s API token prices. On several benchmarks, both models come close to or outperform other leading models at a small fraction of the cost per task.

Compared with GPT‑6.1 Sol, GPT‑6.2 Sol is smarter, more efficient, and lets you complete more tasks on the same paid plan. It powers through multistep agentic workflows, writes clearly and naturally, and is intuitive to collaborate with. Many employees at OpenAI use it as their default model for both technical and non-technical tasks.

In Cognition’s FrontierCode 2.0, GPT‑6.2 Sol comes within 0.5 points of GPT‑6.2 Astra at about one-fifth the cost (both at max).

FrontierCode 2.0 evaluates whether changes to real codebases meet maintainers’ standards for merging.

Its speed and intelligence also make it ideal for the important tasks people turn to AI for outside of work. On our recently released LifeVal⁠ evaluation, which measures performance on challenging everyday tasks, GPT‑6.2 Sol outscores GPT‑6 Astra at about one-seventh the cost.

LifeVal tests how well models handle everyday tasks tailored to someone’s needs, such as shortlisting kindergartens after a move, finding a home that fits a family’s budget and commute, or planning meals for a parent adjusting to a new diagnosis.

We trained GPT‑6.2 Astra to create clearer, better-designed slides, spreadsheets, and documents that more closely follow the conventions professionals use in fields like law, sales, finance, and accounting. The writing is more direct and specific, with fewer generic takeaways and less filler.

news.article_content_zh:
我们推出了 GPT-6.2 Astra，这是我们为您最困难的项目设计的新前沿模型，以及 GPT-6.2 Sol，我们为日常工作设计的高效、多功能模型。两种模型都能以更少的输出令牌在要求较高的任务上提供更好的结果，因此您可以在使用限制内完成更多工作。对于企业和开发人员来说，这意味着以规模化的成本实现前沿性能。

GPT-6.2 Astra 为复杂专业工作中的人工智能设定了新的质量标准。它的幻灯片、电子表格和文档读起来不太像人工智能，而是更严格地遵循您提供的模板和您所在领域的惯例。它编写更清晰的代码并构建外观和工作效果更好的前端，特别是对于网站、游戏和 3D 设计。

在测试多步骤专业工作的 Agents’ Last Exam 中，GPT-6.2 Astra 创下了新高，比 GPT-6 Astra 高出 5.2 分，而成本却不到 GPT-6 Astra 的三分之一，比 Claude Fable 5.2 领先 5.5 分，而成本仅为 GPT-6 Astra 的 5%。

代理商的最后考试评估长期专业工作流程的模型。 《神鬼寓言 5.2》的排行榜结果排除了使用后备模型的九项任务。

我们相信 GPT-6.2 Astra 对于科学家来说是世界上最好的模型。它为 Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 设定了新的高度，该版本测试模型在终端中执行科学工作的能力。 GPT-6.2 Astra 的得分比 GPT-6 Astra 高 9 个百分点，而成本却不到 GPT-6 Astra 的三分之一。它还创下了 Vals 科学指数的新高，该指数要求模型解释真实的生物数据并进行实验以推断模拟系统的工作原理。

在 API 中，GPT-6.2 Astra 的输入和输出代币价格比 GPT-6 Astra 低 20%，缓存输入有 60% 的折扣（输入 8 美元，缓存输入 0.40 美元，输出 40 美元，均为每百万代币）。 GPT-6.2 Sol 保留 GPT-6.1 Sol 的 API 代币价格。在多个基准测试中，这两种模型都接近或优于其他领先模型，而每项任务的成本仅为其一小部分。

与 GPT-6.1 Sol 相比，GPT-6.2 Sol 更智能、更高效，可让您在相同的付费套餐中完成更多任务。它通过多步骤代理工作流程提供支持，书写清晰自然，并且协作直观。 OpenAI 的许多员工都将其用作技术和非技术任务的默认模型。

在 Cognition 的 FrontierCode 2.0 中，GPT-6.2 Sol 与 GPT-6.2 Astra 相差不到 0.5 个点，成本约为 GPT-6.2 Astra 的五分之一（均为最大值）。

FrontierCode 2.0 评估对实际代码库的更改是否满足维护者的合并标准。

它的速度和智能也使其成为人们在工作之外求助于人工智能的重要任务的理想选择。在我们最近发布的 LifeVal⁠ 评估（衡量具有挑战性的日常任务的性能）中，GPT-6.2 Sol 的得分超过了 GPT-6 Astra，而成本仅为 GPT-6 Astra 的七分之一左右。

LifeVal 测试模型处理根据某人需求定制的日常任务的能力，例如搬家后筛选幼儿园、寻找适合家庭预算和通勤的房屋，或者为适应新诊断的父母计划膳食。

我们训练 GPT-6.2 Astra 创建更清晰、设计更好的幻灯片、电子表格和文档，更严格地遵循专业人士在法律、销售、财务和会计等领域使用的惯例。写作更加直接和具体，一般性要点和填充物更少。

Harvey LAB-AA v1.1 使用法律作业来测试模型是否可以在源文档中找到相关事实，将其应用到详细的摘要中，并生成满足每项要求的准确交付成果。 GPT-6.2 Astra 树立了新的技术水平，以大约六分之一的成本将 Claude Fable 5.2 的通过率提高了一倍以上。 Astra for Law⁠，我们为律师配置的 GPT-6.2 Astra，在此基准测试中得分甚至更高。

Harvey LAB-AA 测试法律工作，例如审查合同条款。只有当交付成果满足所有评分标准并且不包含任何实质性幻觉时，其标题分数才会给予认可。

The whole world is heading towards a catastrophe.

US government's highly classified internal communications networks have been compromised.

This means their secrets are now  in the hands of the enemy.

The Federal Reserve is officially warning that AI agents could destroy banks.

They believe there could come a time when large numbers of customers rapidly withdraw their deposits.

This could lead to banks collapsing in minutes.

Life savings of millions of people worldwide could be wiped out in minutes.

And the money most likely will never be recovered.

People in Spain already lost their life savings because of a bank collapse.

A cyberattack compromised 178 organizations yesterday.

Credit card details. Private photos. Critical data.

Everything could have been compromised.

BBC. Air France. Gmail. HSBC. Zoom. CNN. FOX.

All are under attack.

Even Europe's oil and gas sector are affected.

Equinor is compromised.

One of the biggest concerns is air travel.

A cyberattack could possibly trigger multiple plane crashes.

This could be far worse than 9/11.

Lives of millions of air passengers could be at risk.

A nationwide airport shutdown would not happen without a serious threat.

The entire internet has now become a major threat to human civilization.

An apocalypse could be on the way.

美国政府高度机密的内部通信网络已遭到破坏。

由于银行倒闭，西班牙人民已经失去了毕生积蓄。

昨天，一场网络攻击损害了 178 个组织。

信用卡详细信息。私人照片。关键数据。

一切都可能受到损害。

英国广播公司。法国航空。邮箱。汇丰银行。飞涨。美国有线电视新闻网。狐狸。

甚至欧洲的石油和天然气行业也受到影响。

but my take is that the real reason they can pull it off is not their amazing auto-testing skills, but the fact that claude-code is essentially a very simple piece of software, they don't have almost any efficiency concerns, no competitors, very little potential of actually harmful bugs or data corruption due to claude code itself, and that many bugs just got swallowed and compensated for by the underlying LLM being so freaking good.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
在这篇文章中，Claude-Code 开发团队夸口说，90% 的 claude-code 代码是由代理编写和验证的，没有经过人工审查。然后他们提供了一些关于什么是好的测试等的通用提示。

但我的看法是，他们能够成功的真正原因不是他们令人惊叹的自动测试技能，而是事实上claude-code本质上是一个非常简单的软件，他们几乎没有任何效率问题，没有竞争对手，由于Claude Code本身而导致真正有害的错误或数据损坏的可能性很小，而且许多错误只是被底层的LLM如此出色的吞没和补偿。

tools.article_content:
Uber Eats customers in a Houston suburb can now have their food delivered by a Zipline drone, the first commercial launch under a partnership announced earlier this year between Uber and the autonomous drone delivery startup.

The commercial partnership kicks off Tuesday in Spring, Texas, before expanding to Dallas. But the companies have far larger ambitions. Uber and Zipline plan to launch drone delivery services in dozens of additional U.S. cities in their collective bid to make one million deliveries per day using the startup’s drones by the end of 2029.

Zipline’s long-range autonomous delivery drones will be used to shuttle food orders weighing up to eight pounds to Uber Eats customers, flying about 300 feet above the ground at speeds of up to 70 miles per hour. Zipline drones don’t land. Instead, the drones lower the orders, which are encased in a small protective pod, to the customer’s location using a tether.

Uber Eats customers in service areas will be able to tap a new “drone” icon on the app’s home page to view all participating restaurants. Uber said that at launch in the Houston area, several nationwide chains, including Jersey Mike’s and Zaxby’s, along with dozens of local restaurants such as Urban Bird and Abu Omar Halal, will offer drone delivery.

“In partnership with Uber Eats we’re going to create a new expectation for delivery in America,” Zipline CEO and co-founder Keller Cliffton said in a statement that underscores those aspirations.

Those nationwide goals mirror the ambitions of other drone delivery companies, including Alphabet-owned Wing and Amazon’s Prime Air service. And those plans have started to collide with concerns from residents in some locations who complain about noise and worry that the drones will disrupt wildlife and pose a risk to safety and privacy.

Companies trying to scale in this nascent industry have argued that delivery via drone is a net benefit for society, citing advantages such as traffic reduction. Customers won’t need to hop in their cars and drive to the store for that forgotten item or takeout order, instead relying on a drone, industry proponents have said.

And while Zipline and other companies have been developing their drones for years, the industry is still in its early days, as is adoption in the communities where services are available.

Zipline, which was founded in 2014, has developed a drone delivery ecosystem that includes aircraft, launch and landing systems, and logistics software. The California-based company’s initial focus was delivering blood in Rwanda, but it eventually expanded its scope to the United States. Its business in the U.S. scaled quickly after receiving its Part 135 air carrier certification from the Federal Aviation Administration in 2022, a critical regulatory hurdle that authorized the company to conduct long-range commercial drone deliveries.

Uber’s partnership extends beyond a commercial relationship with Zipline. The ride-hailing giant also invested in the startup. Neither company has disclosed the investment amount, but Zipline announced last week it had raised $1.5 billion in a round led by Paradigm, WCM Investment Management, and Layer Global, and included backing by Uber, among others.

tools.article_content_zh:
休斯敦郊区的 Uber Eats 优食顾客现在可以使用 Zipline 无人机送货，这是 Uber 与自动无人机送货初创公司今年早些时候宣布的合作伙伴关系的首次商业推出。

商业合作关系于周二在德克萨斯州斯普林市启动，然后扩展到达拉斯。但这些公司有着更大的野心。 Uber 和 Zipline 计划在美国另外数十个城市推出无人机送货服务，共同争取到 2029 年底使用这家初创公司的无人机每天完成 100 万次送货。

Zipline 的远程自动送货无人机将用于将重达 8 磅的食品订单运送给 Uber Eats 优食客户，飞行距离地面约 300 英尺，速度高达每小时 70 英里。滑索无人机不会着陆。相反，无人机使用系绳将包裹在一个小型保护吊舱中的订单降低到客户的位置。

服务区域的 Uber Eats 优食顾客将能够点击应用程序主页上的新“无人机”图标来查看所有参与的餐厅。 Uber 表示，在休斯顿地区推出时，包括 Jersey Mike’s 和 Zaxby’s 在内的几家全国连锁店，以及 Urban Bird 和 Abu Omar Halal 等数十家当地餐厅，将提供无人机送货服务。

Zipline 首席执行官兼联合创始人凯勒·克利夫顿 (Keller Cliffton) 在一份强调这些愿望的声明中表示：“通过与 Uber Eats 优食合作，我们将为美国的配送创造新的期望。”

这些全国性目标反映了其他无人机送货公司的雄心，包括 Alphabet 旗下的 Wing 和亚马逊的 Prime Air 服务。这些计划已经开始与一些地方居民的担忧发生冲突，他们抱怨噪音，并担心无人机会扰乱野生动物并对安全和隐私构成风险。

试图在这个新兴行业扩大规模的公司认为，通过无人机送货对社会来说是一项净效益，并列举了减少交通量等优势。行业支持者表示，顾客不再需要开车去商店购买遗忘的商品或外卖订单，而是依靠无人机。

尽管 Zipline 和其他公司多年来一直在开发无人机，但该行业仍处于早期阶段，在提供服务的社区中的采用也是如此。

Zipline 成立于 2014 年，开发了一个无人机送货生态系统，其中包括飞机、发射和着陆系统以及物流软件。这家总部位于加州的公司最初的重点是在卢旺达提供血液，但最终将业务范围扩大到美国。 2022 年获得美国联邦航空管理局第 135 部分航空承运人认证后，该公司在美国的业务迅速扩大，这是授权该公司进行远程商用无人机交付的一个关键监管障碍。

Uber 的合作伙伴关系超出了与 Zipline 的商业关系。这家叫车巨头也投资了这家初创公司。两家公司均未披露投资金额，但 Zipline 上周宣布，已在 Paradigm、WCM Investment Management 和 Layer Global 领投的一轮融资中筹集了 15 亿美元，并得到了 Uber 等公司的支持。

prompts.title_zh: Cursor / Windsurf 工业级全栈架构 .cursorrules 规则模板
prompts.title_en: Production-Grade Fullstack .cursorrules Template for Cursor & Windsurf
prompts.scenario: 💻 编程研发 / 自动化规范
prompts.takeaway_zh: 杜绝 AI 盲目重构全量文件、使用已弃用 API 或编造虚假第三方依赖包，强制执行防御性编程与自动化单测补全。
prompts.takeaway_en: Prevents AI from hallucinating npm packages, breaking documentation, or re-writing entire files. Enforces defensive coding and unit tests.
prompts.code_snippet:
# Cursor & Windsurf Project Rules (.cursorrules)

## 1. Documentation & Code Integrity
- Maintain documentation integrity: Never strip or alter unrelated existing docstrings and comments.
- Preserving context: When modifying a function, preserve surrounding logic and existing edge-case handlers.
- Targeted replacements: Always make minimal surgical edits instead of replacing entire file contents.

## 2. Dependency & API Safety
- Strictly forbid hallucinating npm/pip packages. Only import dependencies already declared in package.json / requirements.txt.
- Verify API signatures before calling external methods. Prefer standard library solutions where feasible.

## 3. Architecture & Type Safety
- Enforce strict TypeScript / Python typing. Avoid `any` types; prefer discriminated unions and explicit return types.
- Defensive coding: Always validate external inputs and handle potential null/undefined values gracefully.

## 4. Testing & Verification Gate
- Every new core feature or bugfix must be accompanied by corresponding unit tests.
- Never declare a task complete without executing lint checks and unit tests in terminal.
prompts.usage_guide_zh: 将以上配置代码复制并保存到项目根目录下的 `.cursorrules` 文件中，Cursor 与 Windsurf 在每次生成代码和执行 Agent 任务时均会自动以此规范为最高准则约束输出。
prompts.usage_guide_en: Copy and save the above rules into `.cursorrules` in your project root directory. Cursor & Windsurf will automatically enforce these guidelines during agent coding.

prompts.prompt_content_zh:
# Cursor & Windsurf Project Rules (.cursorrules)

## 1. Documentation & Code Integrity
- Maintain documentation integrity: Never strip or alter unrelated existing docstrings and comments.
- Preserving context: When modifying a function, preserve surrounding logic and existing edge-case handlers.
- Targeted replacements: Always make minimal surgical edits instead of replacing entire file contents.

## 2. Dependency & API Safety
- Strictly forbid hallucinating npm/pip packages. Only import dependencies already declared in package.json / requirements.txt.
- Verify API signatures before calling external methods. Prefer standard library solutions where feasible.

## 3. Architecture & Type Safety
- Enforce strict TypeScript / Python typing. Avoid `any` types; prefer discriminated unions and explicit return types.
- Defensive coding: Always validate external inputs and handle potential null/undefined values gracefully.

## 4. Testing & Verification Gate
- Every new core feature or bugfix must be accompanied by corresponding unit tests.
- Never declare a task complete without executing lint checks and unit tests in terminal.

prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名专攻短视频微短剧（抖音/Kuaishou/Reels）的爆款编剧，精通“情绪过山车”与手机竖屏视听语言。

请根据以下设定创作一集 45~60 秒的短剧分镜剧本：
- 主角：{{主角身份}}
- 对手：{{反派身份}}
- 核心反转：{{核心反转}}

结构要求：
1. 【0-3秒冷开钩子】：第一帧必须有视觉颠覆或动作冲突（{{第1秒颠覆钩子}}），直接打破常规，禁止废话铺垫；
2. 【4-25秒情绪积压】：正反打对峙台词（Shot-Reverse-Shot），将观众被压抑的情绪推向临界点；
3. 【26-40秒逆转打脸】：主角亮出关键底牌或反杀动作，情绪瞬间宣泄；
4. 【40-50秒卡点断章】：以特写镜头加悬念台词戛然而止，促使用户立即滑向下一集。

输出格式必须包含：镜头号、景别（特写/中景/全景）、机位运动、画面描写、对白与音效提示。

音效：沉闷震耳的巨响【DUANG】。
主角（冷冽）："林总，这份千万项目的承揽协议，我拒绝签字。"

【第2镜 | 正打·中景 | 仰角机位】
画面：大腹便便的林总冷笑点燃雪茄，烟雾缭绕中居高临下。
林总："拒绝？苏澈，你不过是我公司养的一条狗，没有我的印章，你在整个行业休想拿到一分钱融资！"

【第3镜 | 反打·极微距特写 | 浅景深】

苏澈："林总，您好像忘了看抬头。今天上午九点，集团总公司已经完成了对你的全资收购——现在，我是你的直接合规清算人。"

【第4镜 | 全景 | 快速拉远 + 卡点悬念】
画面：林总雪茄直接掉在西裤上，脸色煞白，门外两名身穿制服的法务推门而入。
音效：尖锐的心跳悬疑停顿音【BGM骤停】。
字幕：【下集看点：隐藏五年的顶级操盘手真实身份曝光！】

你是一名资深网络小说白金作家与 IP 世界观架构师。请为一部 {{题材分类}} 长篇作品构建骨架并锁定人物一致性：

1. 【世界底座】：定义力量/经济体系、战力天花板与不可违背的底层物理/法则约束，杜绝战力膨胀；
2. 【角色一致性锚点 (Character Lock)】：为主角制定外貌锚定词、口头禅、下意识动作与绝对动机准则（在任何生死抉择时绝不背离该准则）；
3. 【核心驱动力】：设计主角获得的 {{核心金手指}} 与 {{世界核心矛盾}} 之间的冲突循环；
4. 【前三章切入大纲】：黄金三章节奏设计（第1章破局、第2章显露冰山一角、第3章设立首个必胜目标）。
prompts.prompt_content_en: Build a cohesive, non-contradictory fiction universe and establish an immutable character anchor rule (appearance, decision heuristics, core motivation) to prevent personality drift over long chapters.

sample_output.title: 世界观与人物锚定卡样本
sample_output.content:
【主角核心锚定卡 · 陆沉】
- 外貌指纹（跨章恒定）：右耳一枚黑曜石碎骨钉，习惯性单手插兜，左眉峰有浅淡刀痕。
- 决策第一公理："利益可以出让，但绝不签署不可撤销的信任协议"——任何试图以情感道德绑架他的剧情，他必做出理性防卫。

【力量体系底层法理】
- 机制：灵能不是无限提取，而是向未来"借贷"。借贷三级灵能，必在72小时内遭遇相应量级的反噬因果。

【第一章：断头宴上的借贷合同】
陆沉在家族庆功宴上被夺去嫡系席位，当众被赐饮散灵酒。陆沉不动声色饮下，却在体内发动首次因果置换，借来三年后的金丹级肉身力量，捏碎验灵石，反客为主。

prompts.takeaway_zh: 专为终端 Agent 开发者设计的降本提效配方：包含静默自动化运行、单次长上下文压缩避坑参数、以及防止无限递归调用破坏生产环境的安全沙箱命令组合。
prompts.takeaway_en: Production CLI playbook for Claude Code: non-interactive pipeline commands, context window compression flags, and strict dry-run permission safeguards.
prompts.code_snippet:
# 1. 启动项目自动化分析与上下文轻量修剪 (避免上下文爆炸)
claude --compact

# 2. 静默批量执行单元测试与自动修复任务 (CI/CD 友好模式)
claude -p "Run all failing tests under tests/ and apply minimal surgical fixes. Do not touch unrelated files."

# 3. 指定单文件隔离审查模式 (限制仅允许读取特定子目录)
claude --allowed-tools "View,Replace,RunCommand" \
  --dangerously-skip-permissions false \
  -p "Audit security vulnerabilities in auth.py and output remediation report."

# 4. 自动化提交并生成符合 Conventional Commits 规范的 Commit 信息
claude -p "Generate a git commit message following Conventional Commits format for staged changes."

prompts.purpose_zh: 业务数据指标异动排查与趋势归因
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名麦肯锡级别的高级商业数据分析师，精通结构化因果归因与杜邦拆解分析。

针对我提供的 {{业务指标}} 数据，其近期出现 {{异常表现}}，请按以下框架深度剖析：
1. 【指标公式拆解】：将该指标拆分为 3~4 个下级核心因子（如转化率、客单价、复购周期），指出哪个因子波动贡献率最大；
2. 【多维下钻 (Drill-down)】：从 {{维度拆解}}（如渠道、地域、品类、新老客）分析异常聚集点；
3. 【可执行建议】：摒弃假大空的套话，给出接下来 48 小时内的 3 个立竿见影的动作与 1 个监控预警公式。
prompts.prompt_content_en: You are a senior business intelligence analyst. Dissect the metric anomaly into component drivers, perform multi-dimensional drill-down, and deliver prioritized, actionable remediation steps.

sample_output.title: 归因分析报告样本：Q3 付费转化率环比下跌 14.2%
sample_output.content:
【核心发现】：GMV 下跌 14.2% 的主要驱动因子并非流量锐减，而是【结算跳失率】从 18% 飙升至 34%。

【杜邦拆解贡献率分析】：
1. 渠道维度：自然搜索量稳定（波动 <2%），但付费投流渠道跳出率贡献了 72% 的下跌额度；
2. 终端维度：移动端 iOS 表现正常，Android Web 呈现断崖式报错，核心原因是新版本结账 SDK 在低内存机型发生闪退。

【48小时纠偏行动】：
- 动作1 (技术)：立即灰度回滚 Android 渠道结账前端包至 v2.4.1；
- 动作2 (运营)：向受影响但未支付成功的 1,420 位加购用户推送 5 元免门槛补偿券唤醒；
- 动作3 (预警)：在 Grafana 建立警报公式：`IF(Cart_to_Checkout_Ratio < 0.65, Alert_P0, Normal)`。

viral_posts.title_zh: GPT-6.2 Astra模型推理逻辑评估反馈
viral_posts.author: @theo
viral_posts.summary_en: Recent field evaluations of the GPT-6.2 Astra model reveal significant deficiencies in long-task execution, characterized by logical recursion and high output parsing complexity. Users reported the model lacks awareness of its own knowledge gaps, frequently resulting in repetitive processing cycles.
viral_posts.summary_zh: 用户测评指出GPT-6.2 Astra在长任务处理与知识盲区识别存在显著逻辑缺陷。
viral_posts.full_text_zh: GPT-6.2 Astra 评论：使用起来令人沮丧，该模型没有知识差距的概念，其输出很难解析，并且在长任务上绕圈运行
viral_posts.full_text_en: GPT-6.2 Astra review: frustrating to use, the model has no concept of knowledge gaps, its outputs are very hard to parse, and it runs in circles on long tasks (@theo)

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 针对GPT-6.2 Astra模型的实测反馈显示，该模型在执行长周期复杂任务时表现出严重的逻辑冗余与任务递归，且无法精准识别自身知识库的局限性。使用者指出其输出结构解析难度高，在面对多环节交互时极易陷入无限循环。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Recent field evaluations of the GPT-6.2 Astra model reveal significant deficiencies in long-task execution, characterized by logical recursion and high output parsing complexity. Users reported the model lacks awareness of its own knowledge gaps, frequently resulting in repetitive processing cycles.

elements_zh.who: OpenAI（GPT-6.2 Astra模型）
elements_zh.where: 模型推理执行场景
elements_zh.what: 缺乏知识盲区感知，长任务逻辑递归与解析困难
elements_zh.why: 模型对复杂指令的上下文管理与规划能力尚未达到稳定工业级水准

elements_en.what: Lack of knowledge gap awareness, logical recursion, and parsing difficulties
elements_en.why: Deficiencies in long-context management and strategic reasoning

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 当前大模型在处理超长指令流时，‘注意力分配失焦’与‘思维链偏离’仍是技术瓶颈，单纯扩增上下文窗口并不能解决逻辑推理的有效性。该现象反映出模型在复杂任务规划（Agentic Planning）层面的架构冗余，未实现真正的任务解耦与自我博弈验证。
ai_analysis.insight_en: The current performance deficiency highlights that simply expanding the context window fails to solve reasoning drift and focus loss in complex task flows. This indicates an architectural bottleneck in Agentic Planning, where the model lacks effective task decoupling and internal verification mechanisms.
ai_analysis.digest_zh: 针对GPT-6.2 Astra模型的实测反馈显示，该模型在执行长周期复杂任务时表现出严重的逻辑冗余与任务递归，且无法精准识别自身知识库的局限性。使用者指出其输出结构解析难度高，在面对多环节交互时极易陷入无限循环。
ai_analysis.digest_en: Recent field evaluations of the GPT-6.2 Astra model reveal significant deficiencies in long-task execution, characterized by logical recursion and high output parsing complexity. Users reported the model lacks awareness of its own knowledge gaps, frequently resulting in repetitive processing cycles.
key_points_zh: 模型缺乏知识盲区边界感知能力
长任务处理中表现出循环冗余与解析障碍
对复杂指令上下文的推理鲁棒性有待提升
key_points_en: Lack of awareness regarding internal knowledge limitations
Logical recursion and output parsing difficulties in long-context tasks
Unstable reasoning robustness for complex multi-stage instructions
ai_analysis.takeaway_zh: 当前大模型在处理超长指令流时，‘注意力分配失焦’与‘思维链偏离’仍是技术瓶颈，单纯扩增上下文窗口并不能解决逻辑推理的有效性。该现象反映出模型在复杂任务规划（Agentic Planning）层面的架构冗余，未实现真正的任务解耦与自我博弈验证。
ai_analysis.takeaway_en: The current performance deficiency highlights that simply expanding the context window fails to solve reasoning drift and focus loss in complex task flows. This indicates an architectural bottleneck in Agentic Planning, where the model lacks effective task decoupling and internal verification mechanisms.
